annotation.authors_or_issuer: European Parliament and Council of the European Union
key_provisions_or_claims: Producers must place only safe products on the market (general safety requirement).
Presumption of safety for products conforming to European standards published in the OJ.
Producers and distributors must inform authorities of dangerous products and withdraw or recall them.
Member States must designate market surveillance authorities with powers to ban, withdraw and recall products.
RAPEX rapid information exchange system and Commission power to adopt EU-wide emergency measures.
annotation.summary_en: Directive 2001/95/EC, the EU General Product Safety Directive, requires producers to place only safe consumer products on the market. It sets obligations for producers and distributors, market surveillance powers for Member States, the RAPEX rapid alert system, and standards-based presumption of conformity. It contains no AI or robotics provisions.
